items.title: Man City sign Ndiaye from Everton for £65m
items.summary: Manchester City sign winger Iliman Ndiaye from Everton in a deal worth up to £65m.

items.title: Man City agree £125m fee for Chelsea's Fernandez
items.summary: Manchester City agree to pay a British transfer record fee of £125m for Chelsea midfielder Enzo Fernandez.

items.title: Brughmans joins Liverpool in deal worth up to £30m
items.summary: Liverpool have secured the signing of teenage goalkeeper Lucca Brughmans for the start of the 2027-28 season.

items.title: Sunderland sign Spurs defender Danso on loan
items.summary: Sunderland have signed Austria defender Kevin Danso from Tottenham on a loan deal until the end of the season.

items.title: Newcastle sign Fernandez-Pardo from Lille for £51m
items.summary: Newcastle United sign Belgium forward Matias Fernandez-Pardo from Lille for an initial £51.4m.

items.title: Valencia sign Liverpool's Elliott on loan
items.summary: Liverpool midfielder Harvey Elliott joins Valencia on a season-long loan

items.title: Everton agree to re-sign Grealish on loan as Beto leaves
items.summary: Everton agree a deal for Jack Grealish to return to the club on a season-long loan from Manchester City and Beto leaves for Fiorentina.

items.title: Chelsea goalkeeper Sanchez joins Como on loan
items.summary: Chelsea goalkeeper Robert Sanchez joins Como on a season-long loan after losing his starting spot to new arrival Emi Martinez.

items.title: Aston Villa sign Mbaye and Harwood-Bellis
items.summary: Aston Villa complete the signings of Senegal winger Ibrahim Mbaye from Paris St-Germain and English centre-back Taylor Harwood-Bellis from Southampton.

items.title: Juventus sign Woltemade and Sarr on loan
items.summary: Juventus have announced the arrival of Newcastle forward Nick Woltemade and Tottenham Hotspur midfielder Pape Matar Sarr on season-long loan deals.

items.title: Palace and Sunderland battling for £30m Fofana
items.summary: Crystal Palace attempt to hijack Sunderland's move for Lyon's Malick Fofana.

items.title: Arsenal's Nwaneri joins Dortmund on loan
items.summary: German club Borussia Dortmund signs Ethan Nwaneri on a season-long loan from Arsenal.

items.title: Ahanor announced by two clubs in one day after Chelsea workaround
items.summary: Chelsea announce teenage defender Honest Ahanor will join the club in 2027 after the Atalanta player has completed a loan at Crystal Palace.

items.title: Fulham agree to sign midfielders Angel and Larsson
items.summary: Fulham agree to sign midfielders Manuel Angel and Hugo Larsson from Real Madrid and Eintracht Frankfurt respectively.

items.title: Man Utd fail in bid to sign Leicester midfielder Page
items.summary: Manchester United have failed in an attempt to sign Leicester midfielder Louis Page, while Joshua Zirkzee and Harry Amass are set to stay at Old Trafford

items.title: Brighton agree £15m deal for Millwall winger Azeez
items.summary: Brighton agree a deal to sign 25-year-old Nigeria winger Femi Azeez from Championship club Millwall.

items.title: Arteta joins elite 250 club - but where does he rank?
items.summary: Arsenal's fans are singing about winning the league again under Mikel Arteta. Monday's 1-0 win at Aston Villa demonstrated the strengths they have developed under their long-serving manager.

items.title: Hull sign Ansah and close on Norton-Cuffy
items.summary: Hull City sign forward Ilyas Ansah on a five-year deal from Bundesliga side Union Berlin.

items.title: Arsenal explore late move for Alvarez - Tuesday gossip
items.summary: Arsenal still interested in signing Julian Alvarez, Liverpool reject £30m bid from Nottingham Forest for Trey Nyoni, Borussia Dortmund consider move for Jadon Sancho.

items.title: Barcola - the 'grasshopper' who has overcome setbacks
items.summary: As Liverpool complete a £123m transfer for Bradley Barcola, BBC Sport looks at how he has ridden triumphs and setbacks to reach the top with the help of his family.

items.title: Arsenal agree terms to sign De Almeida from PSG
items.summary: Arsenal agree terms to sign versatile France defender Elisa de Almeida from Paris St-Germain.

items.title: Germany's Wamser completes move to Man City
items.summary: Manchester City complete the signing of Bayer Leverkusen and Germany defender Carlotta Wamser on a four-year deal.

items.title: Man Utd near deal for Mexico's Bernal
items.summary: Manchester United are close to signing Mexico international Rebeca Bernal from Washington Spirit.

items.title: Man Utd sign Swedish winger Jusu Bah for £400K
items.summary: Manchester United have confirmed the signing of Sweden winger Monica Jusu Bah from BK Hacken for just under £400,000.
